How This Screen Solves Hackathon Track 1

NPCI UPI Circle & AP2 Delegated Agent Mandate Architecture

In standard e-commerce, customers type OTPs for every single transaction. But for autonomous AI agents (Claude / ChatGPT), requiring human MPIN clicks on every ₹500 item destroys the agentic user experience.

This simulator demonstrates India's official NPCI UPI Circle framework:

  • The Human Customer (Soham Pawar) sets up a delegated mandate once from their banking app.
  • The Bounded Auto-Cap (₹2,000) guarantees that small, everyday items clear automatically with zero human friction.
  • The Razorpay Escalation Shield guarantees that high-value orders (like the ₹12,999 4K Projector) can never be auto-drained by an AI hallucination.
